A theoretical reconstruction of the Claude Mythos architecture, built from first principles using the available research literature.
repos.blurb: OpenMythos is a theoretical reconstruction of Claude's Mythos architecture implemented as a Recurrent-Depth Transformer (RDT) that loops a subset of transformer layers multiple times per forward pass. It enables compute-adaptive reasoning by allowing variable loop iterations during inference, potentially improving systematic generalization without generating intermediate tokens. The implementation uses input injection at each loop iteration to prevent hidden state drift and includes switchable attention mechanisms (MLA/GQA) with sparse MoE layers.

repos.blurb: Agentic Inbox is a self-hosted email client that runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers infrastructure, using Email Routing for message delivery, Durable Objects for per-mailbox SQLite storage, and R2 for attachments. It provides a full-featured web email interface with an integrated AI agent that can read messages, search conversations, and automatically draft replies using Cloudflare's Workers AI platform. The AI agent automatically generates draft replies for incoming emails but requires explicit user confirmation before sending.
